description: Turn a Jandy AquaLink RS panel’s OneTouch scene on or off (by number 1–6, onetouch_<n>, or its label from iaqualink_list_onetouch), through WebTouch. The panel button is a toggle, so it is pressed only when the scene is not already in the requested state; the scenes are re-read afterwards to confirm. A scene switches several pieces of equipment at once, as configured on the panel. The toggle press was not exercised in the live capture. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

on.description: true = run the scene, false = stop it

name: iaqualink_set_onetouch
